title: PlaceMe: Campus Placement Scheduler
context: Placement cells schedule company slots, rooms and interviews across a busy week, while students juggle overlapping drives.
input: Company slots [start, end), registrations, CGPA (×10 as integers), round durations.

milestones.title: Duplicate registrations
milestones.requirement: Students registered twice for one drive (count array).

milestones.title: Round plans
milestones.requirement: List distinct sets of interview rounds whose durations total exactly 120 minutes.

milestones.title: Rooms needed per hour
milestones.requirement: Simultaneous slots per hour via a difference array.
